% -*- mode: LaTeX; TeX-PDF-mode: t; -*-
\pdfinfoomitdate=1 \pdftrailerid{} \pdfsuppressptexinfo=-1 % reproducible PDF: an unchanged letter rebuilds byte-identical
\input{.relpath-to-latexroot.ltx}  % paths (\latexroot)
\documentclass[11pt]{scrlttr2}    % KOMA-Script letter class
\usepackage{Letter}               % layout and machinery: Letter.sty
\input{student-macros.ltx}        % the student's facts, in one place

\begin{document}
\begin{letter}{}

\LetterLogo

\hfill \today

% --- Advisor letterhead (values in advisor-macros.ltx; do not edit here) ---
\noindent \AdvisorLetterheadName\ \AdvisorLinks\\
\AdvisorLetterheadLineOne\\
\AdvisorLetterheadLineTwo\\
\AdvisorEmailLink

\LetterTitleBlock

\noindent Search Committee,\par\medskip

\LetterOpening  % in student-macros.ltx

\cdcinsert{intro}{the advisor's overall assessment}

\input{Letter-sections}  % which sections print: edit Letter-sections.tex

\closing{Sincerely,}
\end{letter}

\LetterReferences  % prints only if the letter cites something

\end{document}
